dashboard.description: Test and genuine cohorts separated. All feedback ratios show missing data for zero denominators. Verified labels do not establish independent operational accuracy. Inference timing excludes browser rendering.

options.content:
**Actual requests, durable feedback, explicit cohorts.**

Select **test** for the professor demonstration or **genuine** for real operator records. Diagnose a window in AERIS to generate measured traffic. No synthetic production outcomes are inserted.

**No recent requests** → latency has no five-minute sample.

**No ratings / agreement responses** → the denominator is zero.

**No inspected labels** → live accuracy is not measured. Counts below show the support; offline model scores are in AERIS → Model evidence.
